meaning.zh:
“与某人保持距离” 或 “刻意疏远某人”。

这个表达到来的要追溯到古代，意思是 “不让某人靠近自己或保持一个手臂的距离”。在现代英语中，这个表达常用来形容与某人维持一种有意拉开距离的关系，不让对方靠近自己，不论是情感上的还是实际上的。
meaning.en: This phrase has origins dating back to ancient times, meaning "not allowing someone to get close to you or keeping a distance of one arm's length." In contemporary English, this expression is commonly used to describe maintaining a deliberate distance from someone, whether emotionally or physically.

lines.en: She’s been keeping her coworkers at arm’s length since her promotion.
lines.zh: 她升职后就一直跟同事保持距离。

lines.en: He tends to keep new acquaintances at arm’s length until he gets to know them better.
lines.zh: 他通常会对新认识的人保持距离，直到更了解他们为止。

lines.en: After the incident, she decided to keep everyone at arm’s length.
lines.zh: 自从那件事发生后，她决定与所有人保持距离。
